title: Dominic and the Inheritance
author: Rafael Marchetti
blurb: Quentin Whitlock, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
